reviews.text:
I take my dogs here for nail trims.
Very nice, clean, & relaxed facility.
Professional & great service!
Highly recommend!

I cannot say enough wonderful things about this gem!! My dogs are anxious about bath and nails. One of them was to the point of needing VERY heavy sedation at the vet. I took her yesterday for her first appointment with NO sedation and she was able to not only get a bath, but got her nails done, too!! I was shocked!! The vet told me a month ago at the last visit we might have to fully sedate her for a nail trim because she was SO worked up despite the heavy sedation.

I had been taking my male dog there for the last few months for bath and nails. He quickly became comfortable after the first visit showed how calm and happy the other dogs were. In fact, we actually started trimming his nails in the back of my SUV the first visit because he would NOT get out lol. It wasn't until he saw a chocolate lab come say hi at the open trunk as we were hanging out if it 🤣 he got up and went inside, and the rest is history lol.

I took our female there this week to pick up our male dog and they let her see the place. I brought her back the next day to just attempt a bath only and they recommended bringing our male back to be there for support. We did just that, and I was SHOCKED to have picked her up with her nails done as well! Again...NO SEDATION.

Dog whisperers, I swear! 🤣 Everyone here is a gem. They truly care about your fur babies.

Thank you!!!

My long haired German shepherd was groomed to perfection!!! They took so many layers off of her by just de-shedding her. She feels and looks like a new dog. So so so happy with the results. What a wonderful staff and communication was superb. Highly recommend
A highly recommended service, excellent attention, friendliness, and above all, the best treatment and care for my pets. They are the best!
Always a great job and friendly staff!

OMG my Pup Diego and me had the most Wonderful Experience 🥹 Staff was so Lovely, so Friendly and so Professional. Best customer service ever and the place looks so clean and welcoming. Totally my place to go from now on…Love Love Love it💕🙏 Blessings 🐾
Amazing service our fur babies love going here
Sassy absolutely Loves getting a spa day here. She can’t wait to get out of the car & through the door!  They treat her like their own 💖

I can't recommend Diva Doggies enough! The service is unmatched. The care they provide is unbelievable. My little one went in for her first spa day and she was a little nervous on the drive. But immediately they made her feel safe and loved!

When I picked her up, she was like a new puppy! All shampood, conditioned, brushed out, ears and face cleaned,  nails trimmed, and having a blast with her new friends!

Already have another appointment on the books!

My doodle loves having his spa day here!!! The staff is incredibly friendly and they take such good care of our fur baby. They do an amazing job with grooming him and always make sure we are completely satisfied with his cut. He smells amazing after his visit too! Highly recommend you take your pet here!
